contributions.detail: exact - 36 attachment rows sum to 62,070.09, equal to the total $62,070.09 printed at the foot of the attachment and to stated $62,070.09

expenditures.detail: exact in magnitude - 36 attachment rows sum to -22,391.60, whose absolute value equals both the attachment's own printed total ($22,391.60) and stated $22,391.60. Every amount on this attachment is printed in ACCOUNTING PARENTHESES, which the contract defines as negative, so the sign is carried through and the sum is negative by construction, not by error.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page prints a per-page subtotal. Both pre-printed form pages leave SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and the TOTAL cell BLANK - p3 carries only the handwritten 'See Attached' and p5 is entirely empty, not even that. The gates therefore fire at the schedule level against the two attachment totals: contributions 36 rows = 62,070.09 = printed $62,070.09; expenditures 36 rows = 22,391.60 in magnitude = printed ($22,391.60). Both hit to the cent.
itemized.escalation_note: none needed - all three attachment pages are machine-set spreadsheet output, fully legible at 200 dpi, and both schedule totals gate exactly at first read
itemized.notes: Both schedules are 'see attached' and the money is in two machine-set spreadsheet attachments printed sideways on portrait sheets (readable at 200 dpi without re-rendering). THE REDACTION HERE IS TOTAL, unlike this filer's September 2012 report: the black bar covers the whole Address/City/State block, so NO donor geography survives and every donor_city/donor_state is blank with 'redacted' in the note - do not compare this filing's blank geography with the 2012 filing's populated cities, the difference is a redaction difference, not a filer difference. Contribution columns are Date / Person-or-Company / Employer / Occupation / [redacted block] / Amount; the field-shift screen clears (36 names against 36 amounts, and the Employer/Occupation pairs land semantically - Brian King with 'Utah House / Representive', Jake White with 'Clyde Companies / Director of Comm', David Brems with 'GSBS / Principle', four Zions Bank bankers in a block). EXPENDITURE AMOUNTS ARE IN ACCOUNTING PARENTHESES throughout, including the printed total ($22,391.60); the sign is applied per contract and the parenthesised form is preserved in each row note. The attachment's own dates are NOT in chronological order on either side (the contribution list jumps 9/6/2013 back to 8/22/2013 and later to 3/27/2013) - that is how the filer printed it and the rows are kept in printed order. One row's Employer/Occupation pair reads 'Teacher / Retired', which is the reverse of the usual sense but is what the cells say. STALE FORM, as recorded at the totals tranche: this 2013 year-end is filed on the 2012-vintage blank whose interim boxes still name 2012 dates.
